How I work

Three rules I work by.

01

Honest over hype.

Plain, truthful messaging for your brand. I won't promise numbers I can't back up.

02

Made to be used.

Logos that work on a sign, a phone screen and a T-shirt. Websites people can find their way around.

03

Clear and reliable.

Simple timelines, regular updates and follow-through, habits from years of running real operations.

The process

From first message to launch.

  1. 01

    Listen

    We talk through your business, your customers and what you need the work to do.

  2. 02

    Design

    I share concepts and refine them with your feedback until the direction feels right.

  3. 03

    Build

    Websites, templates or apps built and checked on phone and desktop before anything goes live.

  4. 04

    Launch

    Files handed over, sites published, and social channels set up so the work starts doing its job.

About

I learned by doing the work.

My design work started in print. From 2016 to 2018 I worked in production at Stepvonne Graphics & Press in Tema. From 2018 to 2021 I designed for, and helped run, the media and administration of two churches in Accra.

Since 2017 I've freelanced as J-Tech Studio, designing logos, flyers and book covers for beauty brands, fashion, sports academies, ministries, authors and small businesses.

Today, in Doha, I also build with no-code and AI tools. I run my own online store, WiCare Store, I'm developing NicheTrendFinder, and I support gospel artist Jufe Official with design and social media.

I've also worked in operations roles since 2008, so I'm used to deadlines, people and following through. That's how I run every project.
